body:
A bedroom absorbs more than you realize — the loop of unfinished thoughts, the static of a day that never fully powered down, the tension you carry to bed without noticing. Most spaces just hold onto it. Restorative Sleep is built to do something different.

This is the next bundle in Energy Muse's Frequency Formula system — Heather's translation of nearly 40 years of Feng Shui and home-healing knowledge into a modern, room-specific frequency architecture. Each formula is layered in three parts, not stacked randomly, but built like an architecture: one frequency clears the space, one stabilizes it, and one directs it toward what that room is actually for.

For the bedroom, that architecture looks like this:

Clear — 417Hz invites the release of the day's overthinking, disruption, and accumulation, so the room isn't holding onto what you carried into it.

Stabilize — 7.83Hz grounds the room in safety, familiarity, and being held — Earth's own resonant frequency, returning the space to its steadiest baseline.

Direct — 528Hz aims the space toward cellular restoration and emotional reset — the frequency of repair.

Run alone, a single frequency shifts a moment. Run together, the three build a room. This bundle includes all three frequency generators, engineered with precision-etched copper coils and sacred geometry patterning, alongside a display case designed to house them as a cohesive piece and a canvas generator bag for on-the-go use. Heather runs this exact trio in her own bedroom, every night before sleep — clear, stabilize, direct.

Restorative Sleep invites your space into a regulated, consistent state — a room your nervous system can finally power down in.
